title: Navigate links and copy target URL
description: Open Edge, navigate to 'https://www.example.com', click the 'More information...' link, and copy the new URL to the clipboard.
natural_language_instruction: Open Microsoft Edge, navigate to 'https://www.example.com', click on the 'More information...' link. Once the new page loads, select the URL in the address bar and copy it to the clipboard.

metadata.author: benchmark_team
metadata.notes: Tests multi-step browser navigation and link clicking.
